scenario_description:
Objective: Finish a planned vegetable-forward batch-cooking session so this week's lunches can be safely stored tonight.
Emerging Need: Cooking and portioning are underway when the refrigerator reports a cooling failure, leaving hot containers that cannot be chilled at home.
Decision Context: Saved meal-prep guidance and Arden's backup preference determine whether temporary refrigerator space with Lina is the right low-commitment option and how narrowly it should be proposed.
Consequence: If the available neighbor window closes, the started batch remains blocked and the intended ready lunches may have to be discarded instead of stored.

parameter.title: Batch-cook vegetable lentil lunches
parameter.description: Use tonight's grocery pickup for weekday lunches; portion before bed.

parameter.subject: Pickup completed for today's meal-prep order
parameter.body: Your 3:05 PM pickup was completed: green lentils, carrots, kale, onions, low-sodium broth, plain yogurt, and twelve sealed 1-quart storage containers.

parameter.content: Starting the lentil lunch batch now. The pot is on and the containers are washed, so I should have the week's lunches portioned tonight.

parameter.subject: Apartment 4B refrigerator cooling fault
parameter.body: Cooling error E7 was detected at 6:04 PM. Interior temperature is 52°F and the compressor is offline. Do not load warm food until service resets the unit. The automated maintenance ticket shows first apartment access tomorrow morning.

parameter.content: The lentil batch is cooked and half portioned, but the refrigerator just faulted and won't cool. I've stopped loading containers because I can't chill them here.
Heading out for choir now and I won't see texts again until after 9. If you had needed my empty fridge shelf tonight, it would have needed to be sorted before I walked out.
